notes.title: Class Update Available Now!
notes.notes: [p][b]War has evolved. And so have you.[/b][/p][p]The latest [i]Star Legion[/i] update introduces the long-awaited [b]Class System[/b]! Players can now choose between three unique combat roles:[/p][p]🔫 [b]Assault[/b] – Great for direct and aggressive engagements. 🛡️ [b]Heavy[/b] – Tougher and stronger, perfect for holding the front. 🎯 [b]Recon[/b] – Fast and precise, ideal for flanking and stealth.[/p][p]Each class comes with its own [b]loadout[/b], including primary and secondary weapons and visual customization.[/p][p]✅ Share equipment between classes 🛠️ Unlock new weapons and appearances 🤝 Team up and tackle missions with a diverse squad[/p]
